title: Labels for affected_test_selection come from per-module call tracing; protected-path changes under grant
summary: Labeling rule: expected tests = test modules that call at least one function or method defined in a changed file, traced per module at the case file's base commit with a call-only tracer (module import execution excluded). Chosen over revert-and-run (about 11 min of full-suite time per commit, far over the 30 min budget, and dominated by tests added in the same commit) and over the static import graph (that is a competing route, so it cannot also define the label). Known limits: code launched in subprocesses is not traced (e.g. browser_control.py gets an empty label), and labels describe the test suite at the base commit. Case pass rule: recall 1.0 and precision >= 0.5, so select-all cannot win. Protected paths changed under the operator's explicit grant in the ORCH-0004 prompt: policy/orchestrator-os.policy.json (added src/agent_os/orchestrator/eval.py to protected_paths, one line), evals/suites/EVS-TEST-SELECTION.json (new), and eval.py itself (new family, deterministic routes, scorer). No check was weakened.

provenance.author_tier: frontier (Opus 5.5) analysis of deterministic eval output
